My dear [Sir](/person/1143)
I am much obliged for the draft for [£300](/topic/160) which I received this morning as well as for the book which accompanied it.
I am glad to hear that the [Lances of Lynwood](/book/23) have begun to go off so fast

Yours truly

C M Yonge
